author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
The Backwoods free update is live! Dive into revitalized Events and Activities with rebalanced enemies, richer rewards and dangerous new three-star Uninvited Guests looking to crash your party. Earn new drops plus the chance to encounter Appalachia’s first-ever four-star Cryptid: the elusive Bigfoot!
